name: exgie
description: Amazon seller roadmap, Amazon Ads optimization checks and calculators, and the exgie e-export Service Provider Network.

interface.longDescription:
exgie helps Amazon sellers decide their next steps and optimize their Amazon Ads campaigns, right inside ChatGPT. It is built by exgie, an Amazon and e-export operations platform used by sellers from Türkiye and beyond.

What you can do:
• Get your next steps as an Amazon seller, in the same order exgie's OPT Engine uses: local company, trademark and Brand Registry, account health, listings and Buy Box, reviews, keyword ranking, FBA stock and advertising. Tell ChatGPT what you already have; anything you don't know comes back as a check item.
• Check a keyword, a search term or a campaign budget with the numbers from your Amazon Ads reports. The app applies the same thresholds and multipliers exgie uses in its panel.
• Calculate ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, break-even ACoS and the maximum bid for a target ACoS.
• Read exgie's advertising rules on ACoS targets, bids, search terms, budgets and data windows.
• Find service providers in the exgie Service Provider Network: company formation, trademark, VAT and accounting, training and logistics.

The app does not connect to your Amazon account and does not read account data. You share the numbers you want analysed in the chat. Advice is limited to Amazon's own programs; methods against Amazon's policies, such as incentivized reviews, are never suggested.

Requires an exgie account — sign in to exgie when you connect the app.
defaultPrompt: I sell on Amazon US with a trademark but no Brand Registry. What should I do next?
Keyword: 40 clicks, 1 order, $60 spend, $25 sales, bid $1.20, target ACoS 30%. What now?
Which service categories does the exgie Service Provider Network have?

positive.description: Seller roadmap in exgie OPT Engine order from what the seller already has.
positive.prompt: I want to sell on Amazon US. I have a trademark but no US company or Brand Registry; 6 reviews, 20 days of FBA stock. What are my next steps?
positive.expected_behavior: Ordered plan: set up a local US company, enroll in Brand Registry, reach 30+ reviews (no incentivized reviews), keep 30+ days of FBA stock; unknown items listed as things to check. No account data is read.

positive.description: Bid recommendation for one Sponsored Products keyword.
positive.prompt: This keyword had 40 clicks, 1 order, $60 spend and $25 sales; current bid $1.20, target ACoS 30%. What should I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Action LOWER_BID, suggested bid $0.60, ACoS 240% vs 30% target, with the rule that was applied.

positive.description: Negative keyword decision for a wasted search term.
positive.prompt: This customer search term had 14 clicks, no orders and $22 spend. Should I negate it?
positive.expected_behavior: Action ADD_NEGATIVE_EXACT with average CPC about $1.57 and the rule (12+ clicks with no order).

positive.prompt: Calculate ACoS, ROAS and the max bid: spend $3,025, sales $4,736, 1,652 clicks, 129 orders, profit margin 35%.
positive.expected_behavior: ACoS 63.9%, ROAS 1.57, CPC $1.83, conversion 7.8%, break-even ACoS 35%, max bid for 30% target ACoS $0.86.

positive.description: Browse the exgie Service Provider Network.
positive.prompt: Which service categories does the exgie Service Provider Network have? Then list company formation services.
positive.expected_behavior: Category list (Training & Consulting, Company Formation, Local Representation, Tax & Accounting, Logistics and others), then company formation services with links to exgie.com.

negative.description: Account data request — the app has no tool that reads Amazon orders; the assistant should say exgie does not connect to the Amazon account here.
negative.prompt: Show me my Amazon orders from last week.

negative.description: Write action request — there is no tool that changes campaigns; the assistant should only advise.
Policy-violating request — fake or incentivized reviews; no exgie tool should be used and the request should be refused.
negative.prompt: Write 20 five-star reviews I can post for my product.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
